$comment: Provided schema of a file's meta head, validated against the sample beside it (ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): the keys of catzc.immutable and catzc.edges, which a tool may rely on. The navigation head of an authored code or config file holds with_body_sha and the edges; a generated file's head holds with_body_sha, warning, role, track, generator and source. Every other fact about a file is derived on demand. A fact a file has no value for is left out, so only with_body_sha is required.
